# Cover letter — Senior AI Engineer - AWS Bedrock | Agentic AI | Chatbots & Customer Support Auto — CSK Nexus Pty Ltd

I am writing to express my interest in the Senior AI Engineer position at CSK Nexus Pty Ltd. With over a decade of experience in engineering roles spanning testing, data engineering, and applied AI, I have developed a robust skill set that aligns well with your needs for designing and scaling next-generation AI solutions.

My expertise in Python and AWS, coupled with my hands-on experience in building retrieval-augmented generation systems, positions me well to contribute to your team. At Chase Risk & Compliance, I delivered a portfolio of AI applications that included retrieval-augmented generation and operational intelligence, demonstrating my ability to create scalable, reliable AI systems.

While I have not worked directly with AWS Bedrock, my extensive experience with AWS services and my active AWS Certified Developer credential ensure I can quickly adapt to new technologies. I am eager to leverage my skills in Python and RAG to architect and build LLM-powered applications that meet CSK Nexus's high standards for enterprise automation.
